SELECT
  id,
  source_count,
  sources,
  analysis->>'que_paso' AS que_paso,
  (SELECT string_agg(a->>'title', ' | ') FROM jsonb_array_elements(articles) a) AS titles
FROM cluster_analysis
WHERE status = 'ok'
  AND categoria IS NULL
ORDER BY id;

UPDATE cluster_analysis
SET categoria = $2,
    categorized_at = now()
WHERE id = $1;
